description: This file implements utility functions for evaluating and manipulating Unified Expression Language (UEL) expressions within the OFBiz framework. It provides methods for evaluating expressions, setting and removing values in a context, handling variable resolution, preparing expressions for evaluation, and includes custom ELResolver implementations for handling specific data structures like LocalizedMap.

classes.name: UelUtil
classes.description: A final utility class that provides methods for evaluating, setting, and preparing UEL expressions within the OFBiz framework. It also contains nested classes for custom ELResolver implementations and expression handling.

classes.name: BasicContext
classes.description: ELContext implementation for variable resolution, supporting evaluation with a mutable set of variables.

classes.name: ReadOnlyContext
classes.description: ELContext implementation for read-only variable evaluation, used when setting or removing values.

classes.name: ReadOnlyVariableMapper
classes.description: VariableMapper allowing variable resolution but disallowing modification, for readonly contexts.

classes.name: BasicVariableMapper
classes.description: VariableMapper for managing variables in a mutable context, supporting resolution and setting variables.

classes.name: ReadOnlyExpression
classes.description: ValueExpression implementation that wraps an object for read-only access within EL evaluation.

classes.name: BasicValueExpression
classes.description: ValueExpression implementation representing a reference to a variable, supporting get and set operations.

classes.name: ExtendedCompositeResolver
classes.description: Custom CompositeELResolver that implements auto-vivification, especially for variable assignment cases.

classes.name: ExtendedListResolver
classes.description: Custom ListELResolver for handling special list operations, including additions and insertions.

classes.name: ExtendedMapResolver
classes.description: Custom MapELResolver that extends support for LocalizedMap objects, resolving variables with locale considerations.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a UEL expression in a given context and returns the result.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a UEL expression with an expected return type.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a UEL expression in a context, with verbose logging option.

methods.name: removeValue
methods.description: Sets the result of a UEL expression to null in a context, effectively removing the value.

methods.name: prepareExpression
methods.description: Converts an OFBiz-specific syntax expression into a UEL-compatible syntax expression.
